usageNotes: Use this to update an existing sendmail notification endpoint — changing recipients, the from-address, display author, or enabling/disabling the target. Requires `Mapping.Modify` on `/mapping/notifications` combined with either `Sys.Modify`/`Sys.Audit` or `Sys.AccessNetwork` on `/`. Pass the `digest` from the current GET response to guard against concurrent edits; omit fields you do not intend to change, and list any fields to remove in the `delete` array rather than blanking them.

examples.summary: Update the 'ops-alerts' sendmail endpoint to add a second recipient and disable it temporarily

params.comment: Temporarily disabled during mail server maintenance

tips: Use the `delete` array (e.g. ["from-address", "author"]) to revert optional fields to their defaults rather than setting them to empty strings.
The `name` path param must match the pve-configid format (alphanumeric plus hyphens, no spaces).
Fetch the current endpoint with GET /cluster/notifications/endpoints/sendmail/{name} first to capture the digest for safe concurrent-edit protection.
`mailto-user` accepts Proxmox user IDs (e.g. 'root@pam'); those users must have a valid email set in their profile for delivery to work.
